DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その小さい筆は、お客様の物でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: あ、私のです。椅子を畳んだ時に落としました。教えてくださってありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 折畳み椅子から落ちた自分の筆だと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oh, it is mine. I dropped it when I folded the chair. Thank you for telling me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the brush that fell from the folding chair is yours. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 椅子の下にありました。ほかの道具はそろっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: It was under the chair. Do you have all your other tools?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 筆が三本のはずですが、ケースには二本しかありません。今見つかった一本でそろいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ケース二本と見つかった一本で三本そろうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: There should be three brushes, but there are only two in the case. With the one you just found, I have all three.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the two in the case and the one just found make all three. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ケースに戻してから、椅子を持ち上げてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Put it back in the case before you lift the chair.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 戻しました。椅子と画板を一緒に抱えるとまた落としそうなので、画板はかばんへ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 筆を戻し画板をかばんへ収めると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have put it back. I might drop something again if I carry the chair and drawing board together, so I will put the board in my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have put the brush back and will put the drawing board in your bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 描いた紙は、もう乾いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is the picture you drew dry yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。絵を見せながら片付けていたので、筆を数えるのを忘れていました。絵もかばんの平らな所へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 乾いた絵を平らに収納し道具確認忘れを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I was showing my picture as I packed up, so I forgot to count the brushes. I will put the picture in a flat part of my bag too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will store the dry picture flat and forgot to check your tools. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 足元には、ほかに残っていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: There is nothing else left at your feet, is there?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見ました。キャップもケースにあります。道具がそろったので、椅子を持って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: キャップと足元を確認し道具をそろえて帰ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I checked. The cap is in the case too. Now I have all my tools, I will take the chair and go home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have checked the cap and the ground at your feet and will go home with all your tools. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 絵と道具を大切にお持ちください。それでは、また写生を楽しみにいらしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22206-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take good care of your picture and tools on the way home. Come and enjoy sketching here again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 旅程のどの部分を確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which part of your itinerary would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この二つの列車の順番です。最初に普通列車へ乗り、次に乗り換えるところを、自分の言葉で言ってみたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二列車の乗換順序を旅程紙で復唱したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The order of these two trains. I would like to try explaining in my own words how I take the local train first and then change trains.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to repeat the order of the two trains using the printed itinerary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どうぞ。乗り換える駅の名前を先に探してみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Go ahead. First, try finding the name of the station where you change trains.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この丸を付けた駅ですね。そこまで最初の列車に乗り、降りてから次の乗り場を探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 丸印駅まで乗り降車後次乗場を探すと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is this circled station, right? I take the first train there, get off, and then look for the next platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that you ride to the circled station and look for the next platform after getting off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。次の列車の発車時刻も、こちらに書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. The departure time of the next train is also written here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十五分後ですね。乗り換えの前に買い物をする予定でしたが、先に乗り場を確認してからにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 十五分間隔を確認し買物前に乗場を探すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is fifteen minutes later. I was planning to shop before changing trains, but I will check the platform first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the fifteen-minute gap and say that you will find the platform before shopping. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 荷物を運ぶために時間が必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will you need time to carry your luggage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 小さい鞄だけです。階段を探しながら急ぐのが苦手なので、余裕を持って移動したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 小荷物だが移動余裕が欲しいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I only have a small bag. I find it difficult to hurry while looking for the stairs, so I would like to allow plenty of time to get there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that your luggage is small but you want enough time to move between trains. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗り換え駅で分からなければ、旅程のこの部分を職員へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you are unsure at the transfer station, show this part of the itinerary to a staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この部分を折り目の外へ出して持ちます。普通列車で丸の駅へ行き、次の乗り場と時刻を確かめる、という順番ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 旅程を見えるよう持ち乗換手順を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will hold it with this section outside the fold. So the order is to take the local train to the circled station, then check the next platform and departure time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep the itinerary visible and repeat the transfer steps. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順番でご確認ください。それでは、落ち着いてお乗り換えください。よいご旅行を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check those things in that order. Take your time changing trains, and have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住まいの相談で、地図をお使いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you be using a map for your housing consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。自宅から相談したい場所まで、どの道か説明したいです。話す前に、地図へ番号を付けてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住まい相談説明用の自分地図へ番号を書けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to explain the route from my home to the place I want to discuss. May I number the map before I speak?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may add numbers to your own map to explain your housing concern. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身の地図でしたら、説明しやすいよう書き込んでいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: If it is your own map, you may write on it to make it easier to explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まず自宅を一番、曲がる角を二番、相談したい場所を三番にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自宅曲角相談地点の三番号を定める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: First, I will mark my home as number one, the corner where I turn as number two, and the place I want to discuss as number three.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Assign the three numbers to your home, the turning corner, and the location you want to discuss. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その順にお話しいただければ、担当者もたどりやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you explain in that order, it will also be easier for the person in charge to follow.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。道の名前はまだ読めませんが、一番から二番まで歩き、ここで曲がると説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未読道名を番号経路で説明すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I cannot read the street names yet, but I will explain that I walk from one to two and turn here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will explain the route by numbers because you cannot read the street names yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相談したいことは、場所についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is your concern about the location?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 夜に帰ると、この道の途中が暗くて歩きにくいです。市のどの窓口へ相談できるか、担当の方に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 夜道の途中が暗い問題について市の相談窓口を尋ねたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: When I return at night, part of this road is dark and difficult to walk along. I want to ask the person in charge which city office I can consult about it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to ask which city office handles concerns about the dark stretch of road at night. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 地図と、相談用紙を一緒にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please bring both the map and the consultation form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 準備できました。番号を付けた地図を先に広げ、用紙に書いた事情を順番に話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 地図先提示と用紙事情の順序を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I am ready. I will open the numbered map first, then explain the circumstances written on the form in order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will show the map first and then describe the circumstances on the form in order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当へご案内します。地図をお持ちのままお進みください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take you to the person in charge now. Please proceed with your map in hand. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 待っている間に、ご様子が変わりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Has your condition changed while you have been waiting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。先ほどから急に寒く感じます。家を出るときはそうではなかったので、今のことを伝えに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 待合で急に寒く感じ来院前と違うと看護師へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I suddenly started feeling cold a little while ago. I did not feel like this when I left home, so I came to tell you what is happening now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Tell the nurse that you suddenly feel cold in the waiting area, unlike before coming to the clinic. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いつごろからでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この待合室へ座って、十分くらいしてからです。上着を着ても、まだ寒く感じています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 着席十分後の開始と上着後も続く状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: About ten minutes after I sat down in this waiting room. I still feel cold even with my jacket on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it began ten minutes after sitting down and continues despite putting on a jacket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ほかに、今気になっていることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Is there anything else concerning you now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 少し震えています。熱があるかは自分で測っていません。今の様子を担当の方にも見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 震えと未測定を述べ担当確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am shivering a little. I have not taken my temperature myself, so I do not know whether I have a fever. I would like the person in charge to check my condition now too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Mention your shivering and that you have not taken your temperature, and ask to be checked by the person in charge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ知らせます。お一人でいらっしゃいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will let the person in charge know. Did you come alone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 妹が付き添っています。私がここへ来たことに気づいていないので、待っていた席を妹にも伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 妹が付き添いで相談移動を知らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: My younger sister is with me. She has not noticed that I came over here, so I would like her to be told where I was sitting too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that your younger sister is accompanying you and does not know you have moved to seek help. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お席の場所を教えてください。付き添いの方にもお声がけします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell me where your seat is. I will also speak to the person accompanying you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 窓の前の二つ目の席です。妹には、私が寒く感じて相談していると伝えてください。今はここで担当の方を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 窓前第二席を示し妹への連絡内容を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: It is the second seat in front of the window. Please tell my sister that I am asking for help because I feel cold. I will wait here for the person in charge now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Identify the second seat in front of the window and request the message to your sister. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ引き継ぎ、妹さんにもお声がけします。こちらでお待ちください。どうぞお大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will hand this over to the person in charge and speak to your sister too. Please wait here. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 手帳をなくされたというご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like help because you have lost your planner, is that right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。駅からここまでの間で気づきました。友人は先に探しに行ったので、どこを探すか連絡したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人と手帳探索範囲を連絡したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I noticed it between the station and here. My friend has already gone to look for it, so I want to contact them about where we should search.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help contacting your friend to coordinate the areas to search for your planner. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後に手帳をお使いになった場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me where you last used the planner.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駅のベンチです。出る前に予定を書きました。それから鞄の外側のポケットへ入れたつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 駅ベンチで最後に使い鞄外ポケットへ入れたと思うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: On a bench at the station. I wrote down my plans before leaving. Then I thought I put it in the outside pocket of my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you last used it on a station bench and believe you put it in your bag's outside pocket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 友人の方は、どちらへ向かわれましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 駅へ戻っています。私は今ここで相談していると伝え、ベンチの周りを確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人駅周り本人警察相談の分担を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Back to the station. I will tell them I am asking for help here now and ask them to check around the bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the division of tasks: your friend searches around the station while you consult the police. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 手帳の特徴を、友人の方へ伝えてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you told your friend what the planner looks like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 茶色の表紙だけ伝えました。内側に私の名前があることと、小さい青いしおりが入っていることも送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 表紙氏名青しおりの追加特徴を友人へ送る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have only told them it has a brown cover. I will also send them the details that my name is inside and it has a small blue bookmark.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Send your friend the additional identifying details: the cover, your name, and the blue bookmark. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらにも届出の状況を確認したいということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: You would also like us to check whether it has been reported here, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。ここで問い合わせを済ませたら友人へ結果を知らせます。友人が見つけたら、探すのを続けず私へ連絡してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 問い合わせ結果共有と発見時連絡を頼むと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. When I finish asking here, I will tell my friend the result. If my friend finds it, I will ask them to contact me instead of continuing the search.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will share the inquiry result and ask your friend to contact you if it is found. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お手元の情報で確認を進めます。それでは、友人の方へもご連絡ください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check using the information you have. Please contact your friend too. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒の宛名を書く場所をお尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking where to write the address on the envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 横に長い封筒です。中には折らない書類を入れました。縦に持つと字を書く場所が狭いので、横向きで書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 折らない書類の横長封筒へ横書きを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a wide envelope. I have put documents inside without folding them. If I hold it vertically, there is little room to write, so I want to write horizontally.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to address a wide envelope horizontally with unfolded documents inside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この向きで、受取人の住所と名前を中央の空いた所へお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: With it facing this way, write the recipient's address and name in the blank space in the center.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここですね。右上に空きを残して、名前が端へ寄らないように書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 中央宛名右上空白の配置を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here, right? I will leave space in the upper right and write the name so it is not too close to the edge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the central address placement and the blank upper-right corner. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 差出人の住所も、お忘れなくお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please remember to write the sender's address too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 裏へ書きます。表には受取人、裏には自分の住所と名前を入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 表受取人裏差出人の記載を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will write that on the back. The recipient goes on the front, and my own address and name on the back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the recipient goes on the front and the sender on the back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記入するペンはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have a pen to fill it in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 黒いペンがあります。紙の下に当てる物を借りられますか。中の書類に筆圧が付かないよう、一度取り出して書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 書類を抜いて記入用の下敷きを借りたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a black pen. Could I borrow something to put under the paper? I would like to take the documents out before writing so the pressure does not leave marks on them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to borrow a writing pad and say that you want to remove the documents before writing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの下敷きをお使いください。記入台で書いて、書類を戻す前に枚数をお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please use this writing pad. Write at the counter, and count the sheets before putting the documents back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二枚を取り出して書きました。住所を見直したら二枚とも戻し、封をしてから重さを量ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二枚を戻し住所確認封後計量すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I took out the two sheets and wrote it. After checking the address, I will put both sheets back, seal it, and have it weighed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will put back both sheets, check the address, seal the envelope, and have it weighed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご準備ができましたら窓口へお持ちください。それでは、お待ちしております。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: When you are ready, please bring it to the service counter. We will be waiting. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの用紙を拝見してよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I look at this form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。普通預金の口座開設申込書を書き終えたと思ったら、同じ用紙を二枚重ねて持っていました。一枚だけ提出したいので、今分けてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 口座開設申込書二枚を分け記入一枚を提出したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. When I thought I had finished the ordinary deposit account application, I realized I was holding two copies of the same form together. I only want to submit one, so may I separate them now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to separate the two account application forms and submit the one you filled in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どうぞ。一枚は記入済み、もう一枚は未記入でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do. Is one filled in and the other blank?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そのとおりです。上に書いた一枚は全部記入し、下の一枚は白いままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 上記入済下未記入の状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: That is right. I filled in everything on the top sheet, and the one underneath is still blank.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the top sheet is complete and the bottom one is blank. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 記入済みの一枚をお渡しください。未使用の用紙はこちらへお返しいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please hand me the completed sheet. You can return the unused form here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分けました。未使用の方を先にお返しします。書いた用紙は、自分の控え用に写真を撮ってから渡してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未使用返却と本人記入の控え写真撮影を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have separated them. I will return the unused one first. May I photograph the completed form for my own records before handing it over?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will return the unused form and ask to photograph your completed form for your records. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身の記入内容を撮る際は、ほかの方の資料が写らない位置でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: When photographing your own entries, please choose a position where other people's documents will not appear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この自分の鞄の上へ置いて撮ります。写真を保存したら、書いた一枚だけお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分鞄上で撮影保存後一枚渡すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will place it on my own bag here and take the photo. Once I have saved the photo, I will hand over only the completed sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will photograph it on your own bag, save the picture, and then hand over one sheet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お手続きで確認する物も、あわせてお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also show me the items we need to check for the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本人確認の書類を用意しました。記入済み一枚と書類をお見せします。未使用用紙はもう返したので、二枚を一緒に出さずに済みました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記入一枚と本人確認資料を提示し未使用返却済を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have my identification documents ready. I will show you the completed sheet and my documents. I have already returned the unused form, so I avoided handing in both sheets together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Present the completed sheet and your identification, and say that you have already returned the unused form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確かにお預かりしました。それでは、口座開設の相談として記入内容を確認いたします。ご準備ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have received them. I will now check the details as part of your account-opening consultation. Thank you for preparing everything. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お探しの商品を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you tell me what product you are looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: オーブンの天板に敷く紙を買いたいですが、日本語の名前を忘れました。丸い筒に巻いてある物です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 天板に敷く巻紙を外観用途で尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to buy paper to line an oven tray, but I have forgotten its Japanese name. It is rolled into a round tube.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for the rolled paper by describing its appearance and use as an oven tray liner. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: クッキングシートをお探しでしょうか。箱に入った巻く形の商品がございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you looking for baking paper? We have rolls in boxes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: その名前でした。家の天板の幅を書いてきたので、箱の幅表示を見て選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: クッキングシート名を確認し天板幅に合う表示を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: That was the name. I wrote down the width of my oven tray, so I want to choose by checking the width marked on the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the name baking paper and look for a marked width that fits your tray. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 売り場はこちらです。幅の表示は、箱の横にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The section is over here. The width is marked on the side of the box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三十センチと書いてありますね。持ってきたメモと同じ幅なので、この箱を一つ買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 幅三十センチをメモと照合し一箱を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It says thirty centimeters. That is the same width as my note, so I will buy one box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Compare the thirty-centimeter width with your note and choose one box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかにお探しの物はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is there anything else you are looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日はこれだけです。次に来るとき言えるよう、商品名を自分の買物メモへ写してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 商品名を自分メモに写す許可を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Just this today. May I copy the product name into my shopping note so I can say it next time I come?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask permission to copy the product name into your own note. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どうぞ。お選びの箱にも名前がございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Go ahead. The name is also on the box you have chosen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: クッキングシートと書けました。メモを鞄へ戻してから、この一箱をレジへ持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 商品名を控えメモ収納後レジへ向かうと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have written down baking paper. I will put the note back in my bag and then take this one box to the checkout.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have recorded the name and will put away the note before going to the checkout. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらの商品をどうぞ。お探しの物が見つかってよかったです。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is your chosen item. I am glad you found what you needed. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その紙、風に飛ばされそうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: That paper looks as if it might blow away.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人とここで歌の練習をします。歌詞の紙を持ってきましたが、風でめくれるので、準備する場所を変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 歌詞紙が風でめくれ準備場所変更を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am going to practice singing here with a friend. I brought lyric sheets, but the wind keeps turning them over, so I want to change where we get ready.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the wind is turning the lyric sheets and discuss changing your preparation spot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: あちらの木の陰なら、今の場所より風を受けにくいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: In the shade of that tree, you would be less exposed to the wind than here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そこへ移ります。紙は鞄へ戻してから歩き、着いてから一枚だけ出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紙を収納して木陰へ移ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will move there. I will put the papers in my bag before walking and take out just one sheet after I arrive.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will put away the papers and move into the tree's shade. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: クリップはお持ちですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二つあります。上の両端を留めて、ほかの歌詞は鞄の中へ入れたままにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二クリップで一枚固定し残りは収納と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have two. I will clip both top corners and leave the other lyric sheets in my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you will secure one sheet with two clips and keep the rest in your bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご友人にも、移った場所を知らせてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you told your friend where you have moved?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: これから送ります。元のベンチで探さないよう、木の横にいることを写真で伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人へ木横位置を写真で知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will send a message now. I will send a photo showing I am beside the tree so they do not look for me at the original bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will send a photo to tell your friend you are beside the tree. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 紙をしまってから、お帰りくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please put your papers away before you go home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今日は一枚だけ使い、終わったらクリップを外して全部鞄へ戻します。落ちた紙がないか見て帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 練習後収納と落紙確認して帰ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will only use one sheet today, and when we finish I will remove the clips and put everything back in my bag. I will check that no papers have fallen before leaving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that after practice you will put everything away and check for dropped papers before going home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、準備を整えてお楽しみください。周りの方にもご配慮いただき、よい時間をお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please get ready and enjoy yourselves. Be considerate of the people around you, and have a pleasant time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗り換えのご案内をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to look at the transfer information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。携帯の電池が少ないので、途中で画面を見られなくなりそうです。紙の案内もいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 携帯電池不足のため紙の乗換案内を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My phone battery is low, so I may lose access to the screen along the way. Could I also have printed directions?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for printed transfer directions because your phone battery is low. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの案内へ、乗り換える駅と行き先を記してお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will write the transfer station and destination on this guide and give it to you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。今表示されている案内と、同じ経路にしたいです。この画面を見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 画面を示し同経路を紙へ写してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. I want the same route as the directions currently on my phone. I will show you this screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the screen and ask for the same route to be copied onto paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 熱海駅でお乗り換えですね。紙の「熱海」に印を付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You change at Atami Station. I will mark Atami on the paper.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。名前の読み方も書いてもらえますか。駅で聞く時、読めるようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 乗換駅の読み方も書いてほしいと求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. Could you write how the name is pronounced too? I want to be able to read it when asking at the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the pronunciation of the transfer station to be written too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 「熱海」は「あたみ」と読みます。最後の「沼津」は「ぬまづ」です。こちらへ読み方も添えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The name is pronounced Atami. The final station is pronounced Numazu. I will add the pronunciations here too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この駅で合っています。降りる駅には別の丸を付け、自分でも見分けられるようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 到着駅を確認し乗換駅とは別の丸を付ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: That is the right station. I will put a different circle around the station where I get off so I can distinguish them myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the arrival station and mark it with a separate circle from the transfer station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 携帯の案内を閉じる前に、紙と見比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please compare the paper with your phone before closing the directions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 同じ経路になっています。紙は切符と別のポケットに入れ、電池が切れても取り出せるようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 画面と紙の一致を見て切符と別収納すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: They show the same route. I will put the paper in a different pocket from my ticket so I can take it out even if the battery dies.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check that the screen and paper match and say that you will store the paper separately from your ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらの案内をお持ちください。お気をつけてご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take these directions with you. Have a safe train journey.
